transcript: Speaker A: पांच बच्चों के साथ ट्रेन में अकेला छोड़ गया। नमस्ते, मेरा नाम सायरा है। मैं लखनऊ से हूँ। शादी 10 साल पहले हुई थी... [Left me alone on the train with five children. Namaste, my name is Saira. I am from Lucknow. Married 10 years ago...] [Narrates being abandoned by her husband at a station, struggling to find a job or fill forms due to lack of English, discovering the English Seekho app's 1-rupee trial, practicing with the AI coach, securing a call center job, and successfully raising her children with her increased salary] ...इंस्टॉल बटन पर क्लिक कीजिए और इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप डाउनलोड कीजिए। [...Click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.] Speaker B: तो इंस्टॉल बटन पर क्लिक करो और इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]
on_screen_text: English Seekho, INSTALL NOW, [Disclaimer text explaining that the app is not affiliated with any government authority and results may vary based on individual effort]
summary: An emotional narrative about Saira, an abandoned mother of five who overcomes poverty and unemployment by learning English through the English Seekho app. After practicing with the app's AI coach, she secures a job and achieves financial independence. The ad ends with a call to action to download the app for a 1-rupee trial.
